body:
## Mode
Builder + play-tester, Round 72 of the pong-quilt experiment loop (PLAYLOG.md).

## What shipped
The R68 LOAD/COEV banner named the loaded file but not its parent, even though `coev.fileOrigin` is recorded at parse time (R71) — auditing a downloaded quilt's history required training on it first. The banner now prints `(descends from "<origin>")` when `coev.fileOrigin` is set, echoing the value one statement after the load branch records it under the same non-empty-string law; a file without origin banners byte-unchanged.

## FAIL-first (pristine r71 tip, one run)
- LOAD-DISPLAY RED — banner read `loaded C1 file "B": gen 5`, no parent
- TWO-SURFACE-AGREEMENT RED — post-Train stats line carried the claim the banner did not
- NO-ORIGIN HONESTY / MALFORMED-ORIGIN IMMUNITY GREEN by design

Post-fix 4/4 GREEN; sibling pins r68/r70/r71 re-run 33/33 GREEN.

## Verified numbers (all by running)
- Suite at pristine r71 tip: 312 tests, 304 pass / 0 fail / 8 skips; qa 8/8
- Post-change: **316 tests, 308 pass / 0 fail / 8 skips**; qa 8/8
- Canonical post-R50 line byte-exact (coev.js 946e639a…, curve f9b20e7d…, L0 bc15d414…, L1 1125d59c…, L2 50137ceb…, coev-stone-v1 3a0a5fb6…); page glue only
- README 320 → 324 (316 in `tests/` + 8 QA) — `tests/readme-count.test.js` caught this round's own files-not-tests arithmetic slip
- Site dist re-sealed after the index.html/core.js edits, before suite counts (build-order law)
- v1 draw #8 (clean worktree @ e98cf66): 2935 / 6500 / 6125 — L2 tail value now drawn 3×, always 6000f/5h/×3.40: R1's published L2 IS the distribution ceiling

## Carry-forward (R73 spec in PLAYLOG)
1. [M] Lane tracking — franken tail 8th carrying (verbatim probe included) + named refusal receipt [S, new item 5]
2. [S] lineage-visibility disclosure (7th carrying)
3. [S] PLAYLOG baseline integrity w/ L2-attractor note (6th carrying)
4. [S] σ-slider → trail interaction (5th carrying)

## Base
playtest-round-71 tip 5c31324 (PR #90 open, Casey-gated; R22-vs-r21 unmerged-stack precedent). PLAYLOG entry newest-first; index row updated; marker grep EMPTY.
